svg.title: Stage C: MAE by forecast hour, per claim airport
svg.desc: Six small line charts, one per airport, of mean absolute error in degrees C against forecast hour 3 to 48, raw GFS and the curve, look A solid and look B dashed. EDDM look A: lead 3 raw GFS 1.573, curve 1.177; lead 48 raw GFS 1.841, curve 1.379; EDDM look B: lead 3 raw GFS 1.632, curve 1.184; lead 48 raw GFS 2.005, curve 1.472; KORD look A: lead 3 raw GFS 0.940, curve 0.764; lead 48 raw GFS 1.571, curve 1.347; KORD look B: lead 3 raw GFS 0.987, curve 0.852; lead 48 raw GFS 1.551, curve 1.473; CYYZ look A: lead 3 raw GFS 1.291, curve 0.977; lead 48 raw GFS 1.605, curve 1.290; CYYZ look B: lead 3 raw GFS 1.268, curve 0.957; lead 48 raw GFS 1.576, curve 1.261; ZGSZ look A: lead 3 raw GFS 0.918, curve 0.708; lead 48 raw GFS 1.333, curve 1.069; ZGSZ look B: lead 3 raw GFS 0.939, curve 0.739; lead 48 raw GFS 1.263, curve 0.923; ZUCK look A: lead 3 raw GFS 1.317, curve 1.025; lead 48 raw GFS 1.589, curve 1.221; ZUCK look B: lead 3 raw GFS 1.259, curve 0.953; lead 48 raw GFS 1.576, curve 1.149; NZWN look A: lead 3 raw GFS 1.097, curve 0.723; lead 48 raw GFS 1.187, curve 0.865; NZWN look B: lead 3 raw GFS 1.118, curve 0.718; lead 48 raw GFS 1.203, curve 0.869. Source DECISIONS F150, session 107 scores.
svg.text: Stage C: MAE by forecast hour, per claim airport
MAE by forecast hour, per airport, pooled over the four GFS runs a day. Descriptive (D100.8).
